task: Command-pattern undo/redo text Editor with self-inverting commands, atomic macros, bounded history and dirty tracking
reasoning_summary: Commands return their own inverse from apply, so history stores only inverses and undo/redo are symmetric. Validation happens before mutation so failures are side-effect free; macros roll back on failure. Dirty state uses revision numbers rather than stack depth so history truncation and diverging edits stay correct.
